---
title: "Projects"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml
from pathlib import Path

yaml_path = Path(r"E:\Github\Portfolio_Webpage\data\projects.yaml")
data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
projects = data.get("projects") or []

def one_line(s):
    return " ".join(str(s).split())

categories = {}
for proj in projects:
    if not isinstance(proj, dict):
        continue
    cat = proj.get("category") or "Uncategorized"
    categories.setdefault(cat, []).append(proj)

for cat, proj_list in categories.items():
    print(f"## {cat}\n")
    for proj in proj_list:
        status = f" *({proj['status']})*" if proj.get("status") else ""
        print(f"### {proj.get('title', 'Untitled')}{status}\n")

        if proj.get("year"):
            print(f"*{proj['year']}*\n")
        if proj.get("description"):
            print(f"{one_line(proj['description'])}\n")
        if proj.get("problem"):
            print(f"**Problem addressed:** {one_line(proj['problem'])}\n")

        tools = proj.get("tools") or []
        if tools:
            print(f"**Tools:** {', '.join(tools)}\n")

        links = []
        if proj.get("page"):
            links.append(f"[View full case study →]({proj['page']})")
        if proj.get("github"):
            links.append(f"[GitHub]({proj['github']})")
        if proj.get("url"):
            links.append(f"[Project site]({proj['url']})")
        if links:
            print(" | ".join(links))
        print()
    print("---\n")
```
